plotting_plan.title: Reference design: transition profiles and selective context
plotting_plan.objective: Diagram the reference pipeline from sentence units and offsets through normalized transition features, constrained boundaries, retrieval, budgeted context selection, and provenance. Label it as a specification, not a verified implementation diagram.

plotting_plan.title: HotpotQA pilot answer F1
plotting_plan.objective: Use a bar chart for fixed-size chunking (0.358), the nominal velocity-only arm labeled velocity + structure (0.344), and full STP with context (0.410). Mark values as descriptive and note unmatched budgets and the 25-query generation evaluation; do not add significance marks.

plotting_plan.title: QASPER pilot: retrieval and context sensitivity
plotting_plan.objective: Use two labeled bar-chart panels: Recall@5 for fixed-size (0.379), nominal velocity-only, labeled velocity + structure (0.252), and full STP (0.299); and answer F1 for full STP without context (0.105) and with context (0.068). Do not infer an unspecified context condition for the Recall@5 values or add significance marks.

plotting_plan.title: Audit estimates of generator evidence volume
plotting_plan.objective: Use a bar chart showing approximately 960, 345, and 945 evidence tokens for fixed-size, full STP, and full STP with context, respectively. Label these as estimates derived from mean chunk lengths, not per-query counts, and use them to expose a prompt-budget confound rather than explain a causal effect.

introduction_strategy.literature_target: 10–20 verified macro-level papers, subject to availability; prioritize surveys and foundational work rather than the technical baseline papers reserved for Related Work.
introduction_strategy.hook_hypothesis: Investigate whether passage boundaries and context selection are consequential design choices in retrieval-augmented question answering.
introduction_strategy.problem_gap_hypothesis: For the supplied HotpotQA and QASPER pilots, investigate whether local semantic transitions offer a useful segmentation and context-control signal; the mixed, budget-confounded results do not establish general superiority or causal effects.
search_directions: Find foundational work establishing retrieval-augmented generation and the role of retrieved passages in question answering.
Find surveys or reviews of retrieval-augmented generation, document segmentation, and retrieval evaluation.
Find papers documenting practical consequences of splitting evidence or including irrelevant context in question-answering systems, without assuming these effects were measured in this pilot.
Identify 3–5 foundational papers on semantic text segmentation, sentence representation, or retrieval-based question answering; verify their relevance and primary-source details.
introduction_strategy.citation_policy: Use verified primary sources; reserve recent method-specific comparisons for Related Work and avoid duplicating citations across the two sections where practicable.

related_work_strategy.overview: Target 30–50 verified papers across the clusters below if the literature supports them. Search only publications available through 2026-11. Use recent work for conceptual context, not as new experimental competitors; only arms recorded in the experimental log may be described as empirically compared.

subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Find technical studies available through 2026-11 on fixed-size and similarity-based document segmentation and their evaluation. Fixed-size is a pilot arm; similarity-threshold is proposed for the confirmatory protocol only. Do not present untested papers as measured competitors.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Fixed boundaries may split definitions from qualifications or combine unrelated material; whether this harms the supplied datasets remains to be tested.

subsections.bridge_to_our_method: Investigate how the reference transition score and length constraints could adapt boundaries while retaining source offsets.

subsections.methodology_cluster: Local semantic transitions and document structure
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Find technical studies available through 2026-11 using local semantic changes or document structure for segmentation. Compare concepts with the pilot's nominal velocity-only and full-STP arms, noting that the former actually includes structural weighting.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: A single transition cue or structural cue may not capture all relevant boundary behavior; the pilot does not isolate these effects.
limitation_search_queries: semantic transition text segmentation sensitivity local similarity boundaries
document heading structure segmentation semantic boundary disagreement
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: Investigate the proposed combination of velocity, positive acceleration, volatility, and structural indicators; use the planned clean ablations to test their contributions.

subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Find technical studies available through 2026-11 on selecting or expanding context around retrieved passages. The pilot evaluates full STP with and without context; relevance-only and profile-guided context comparisons are planned, not completed.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Uncontrolled context expansion can alter prompt volume and obscure whether selection quality matters; the audit identifies this confound in the present pilot.

subsections.bridge_to_our_method: Describe budgeted, provenance-preserving selection as the reference design and investigate its value under matched prompt budgets in the confirmatory protocol.

content_bullets: From idea.md, define ordered sentence units, source offsets, structural metadata, and fixed L2-normalized embeddings. Do not name an encoder or encoder version.

Formalize adjacent embedding distance as velocity, positive increases in velocity as acceleration, trailing-window volatility, and heading or paragraph indicators. Specify exact distance and window details only if verified; otherwise identify them as unspecified.

Describe development-only median/IQR normalization and a weighted boundary score subject to minimum, target, and maximum length constraints. Do not invent weights, threshold rules, or hyperparameters.
From idea.md, describe ranking nearby source units by embedding relevance, structural affinity, reference/entity overlap, and distance, then appending units within a declared context-token budget.
Specify provenance preservation for chunks and attached units. Do not invent a ranking equation or tie-breaking rule.
Clearly label this as the reference design and separate it from implementation details missing in experimental_log.md.

section_plan.sizing_guidance: Prioritize the audited results and confounds alongside the future protocol; report only supplied numerical values.

content_bullets: Identify HotpotQA and QASPER as the pilot datasets and distinguish fixed-size, nominal velocity-only, full STP, and selective-context conditions as recorded in experimental_log.md.

Call the nominal velocity-only arm velocity + structure when describing its computation. Report that generation metrics use only 25 queries and that 42 of 149 QASPER questions were dropped during evidence alignment.

State that every arm passed its top three chunks to the generator, while chunk counts, indexed material, and prompt/context volume differed. Report the approximately 960, 345, and 945 evidence-token audit estimates as estimates from mean chunk lengths, not per-query counts.
Do not invent encoder version, structural processing, calibrated weights, decoding, retrieval backend, hardware, or per-query records.

Report HotpotQA answer F1 of 0.344 for the nominal velocity-only arm, 0.358 for fixed-size, and 0.410 for full STP with context. The respective 0.066 and 0.052 differences are descriptive, not tests or causal effects.
Note that the nominal velocity-only arm has the strongest reported HotpotQA Recall@5 and MRR; do not claim full STP wins every metric.

Report that fixed-size is best on all four reported QASPER quality metrics; full STP F1 decreases from 0.105 without context to 0.068 with context. Report Recall@5 of 0.379, 0.299, and 0.252 for fixed-size, full STP, and nominal velocity-only, respectively.
Report QASPER chunk counts of 47.959 for full STP and 41.796 for nominal velocity-only. Do not infer section preservation.
Present the largest reported mean retrieval latency, 3.972 ms, only as an incompletely documented retrieval timing, not end-to-end or deployment latency.
State that restored prompt volume is consistent with the HotpotQA context gain and prevents attribution to better context selection. No paired confidence intervals or hypothesis tests are available.
Label the protocol as unexecuted. Specify matched document/question splits, one JSONL row per query and arm, matched chunk-length distributions, and matched generator prompt budgets.

List the planned arms from experimental_log.md: fixed-size, similarity-threshold, clean velocity-only, structure-only, velocity+volatility, velocity+structure, full STP without structure, full STP, relevance-only context, and profile-guided context.

Plan Recall@K, MRR@10, EM/F1, P_k, WindowDiff, evidence split rate, context precision/recovery, index size, build time, retrieval latency, and prompt-token measurements. Define operational measures and evaluation units before execution; do not fabricate outcomes.
Plan paired bootstrap or document-cluster bootstrap, a sign-flip permutation test, and Holm correction, with clustering and comparison families specified before analysis.
subsections.citation_note: Verify primary sources and precise metric definitions. For operational quantities without a uniquely attributable canonical paper, define the measurement explicitly and cite a verified source only if applicable; do not invent a citation.
